```plato

    // The R2 point of the given index: an additive recurrence whose increments
    // are the reciprocal powers of the plastic number, wrapped into the unit
    // square. No bases and no tables, and a lower discrepancy in the plane than
    // Halton. `offset` shifts the whole sequence; 0.5 is the usual choice,
    // because index zero would otherwise sit on the corner.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plastic_ratio
    PlasticPoint2D(index: Integer, offset: Number): Point2D {
        var p = GeneralizedGoldenRatio(2);
        var n = index.ToNumber;
        return Point2D(UnitFraction(offset + n / p), UnitFraction(offset + n / (p * p)));
    }
```
